International fee gap

The programme pays Home-rate tuition and a BHF stipend. International applicants are considered, but must arrange additional funding for the overseas tuition difference. The published course application deadline is 8 December 2026.

About the Project

The BHF cardiovascular programme offers doctoral research training at Cambridge. Applicants are assessed for the programme as a whole rather than only for a single supervisor or project. The checked call gives December 2026 as the closing month; the exact day needs confirmation.

Research Areas

  • Cardiovascular research
  • Medical science
  • Biomedical research

About University of Cambridge

Cambridge offers research degrees through its departments and colleges. Doctoral training programmes in sensors, environmental science and cardiovascular research have their own selection and funding arrangements alongside university admission.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 8 December 2026; check the official course page for the submission time. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
